svg.title: THE HUMAN FIREWALL
svg.desc: Twenty-four chambers classified by what each is permitted to do. Seven fail closed, so that action aimed at a specific at-risk person leaves the machine and reaches a person. Full data is also given as a table in the page text.
svg.text: Seven of twenty-four chambers fail closed. Not because the model is weak — because being confidently wrong there hurts someone specific.
Digital Safety & OpSec for At-Risk People
24 chambers · 7 fail closed · 17 open · checksum 300 = triangular(24) — every figure recounted from the roster, not recalled
A control that routes to a human only works if a human is actually reachable. That is a staffing fact, not a code fact, and no diagram can fix it.
